title: Fiery Crowned Green Oracle
description: A green-skinned woman with closed eyes and a third eye on her forehead is depicted in profile, wearing an ornate crown engulfed in yellow flames and adorned with skulls, red gems, and flowers. Her neck and shoulder bear sketched portraits of multiple faces while the surreal background features a red planet, shooting stars, purple lavender fields, floating geometric shapes, and small human figures walking along a path.
prompt: A surreal portrait of a green-skinned woman in profile with closed eyes and a red third eye on her forehead, wearing an elaborate crown of skulls, red gems, white flowers and bright yellow flames. Sketched overlapping female faces appear on her neck and shoulder. The background is a dreamy cosmic landscape with a red planet, shooting stars, purple lavender fields, floating purple geometric shapes and tiny human figures walking a path, vibrant colors, detailed linework.
